text:
[LCRS.8.1] Every `call` action must state its rate expectations. The
compiler rejects any `call` that carries neither `cooldown: <dur>` nor the
`nocooldown` flag (`DS_VALIDATE_CALL_RATE_MOD`).

tla.name: lcrs_8_1__COOLED
tla.note: The calls that carry `cooldown:`; the rest carry `nocooldown`, and every call carries one or the other. One of the two calls in every config, the one with an author's `as`.
